Hello my name is Michelle Vassallo and welcome to Rhythm Massage Development and education I’m really excited to be able to share my thoughts and my courses with you in a way to reach out to the massage community so that we can create a professional workspace for all the members to come and learn new and interesting and exciting skills I think that I’m passionate about mostly manual lymphatic drainage - here on the youtube channel you'll find some videos to learn about MLD.

Find more about Manual Lymphatic Drainage at www.rhythmmassage.com.au 
#MichelleVassallo #RhythmMassage #MLD #ManualLymphaticDrainage 
Join us on Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/rhythmmassage
